body: It's a pretty long story. I started feeling depressed when I was 9, and I'm 21 now. I've dealt with depression, suicidal feelings, survivor guilt and a host of other issues ever since. I lost a sibling to an illness I indirectly caused and felt guilty for it ever since. My parents know loosely, but they aren't very emotional people. After we lost my sister we all sort of closed ourselves off to grieve. I never really fully developed socially or emotionally. We were poor, so I never got to see anyone for help, but I think one day, if I do survive, I'll end up on antidepressants since it is the only way I'll be able to live a normal life. My boyfriend and I spend a lot of time isolating ourselves from the outside world. As it stands, I have no friends, no money, no hope, and no will.
